customMethods.name: getLogs
customMethods.script:
import os
	from java.io import RandomAccessFile
	from jarray import zeros

	lines = int(payload.get("lines", 500))
	which = int(payload.get("which", 0))			# 0 => wrapper.log, 1 => wrapper.log.1, etc.
	maxBytes = int(payload.get("maxBytes", 1024 * 512))	# default 512KB

	fileSep = system.util.getProperty("file.separator")
	osName = system.util.getProperty("os.name") or ""
	ignitionHome = system.util.getProperty("ignition.home")

	def getRotatedPath(basePath):
		if which <= 0:	return basePath
		return basePath + "." + str(which)

	candidatePaths = []

	# Prefer ignition.home if available
	if ignitionHome: candidatePaths.append(ignitionHome + fileSep + "logs" + fileSep + "wrapper.log")

	# Windows common installs
	candidatePaths.append(r"C:\Program Files\Inductive Automation\Ignition\logs\wrapper.log")
	candidatePaths.append(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Inductive Automation\Ignition\logs\wrapper.log")

	# Linux common installs (varies by install)
	candidatePaths.append("/usr/local/bin/ignition/logs/wrapper.log")
	candidatePaths.append("/usr/local/ignition/logs/wrapper.log")
	candidatePaths.append("/opt/ignition/logs/wrapper.log")
	candidatePaths.append("/var/log/ignition/wrapper.log")

	wrapperPath = None
	for basePath in candidatePaths:
		p = getRotatedPath(basePath)
		if system.file.fileExists(p):
			wrapperPath = p
			break

	if wrapperPath is None:
		containerNote = ""
		if "Linux" in osName and system.file.fileExists("/.dockerenv"):
			containerNote = ("\n\nNote: This Gateway appears to be running in a container. "
				"Official Ignition container images typically send wrapper output to stdout, "
				"so wrapper.log may not exist on disk. Use docker/k8s logs instead.")

		checked = "\n".join([getRotatedPath(p) for p in candidatePaths])
		return {"text": "wrapper.log not found. Checked:\n" + checked + containerNote}

	def tailFileText(path, maxBytes):
		raf = RandomAccessFile(path, "r")
		try:
			length = raf.length()
			start = max(0, length - maxBytes)
			raf.seek(start)

			size = int(length - start)
			buf = zeros(size, 'b')		# byte[]
			raf.readFully(buf)

			# Convert signed Java bytes -> characters
			return "".join([chr(b & 0xFF) for b in buf])
		finally:
			raf.close()

	try:
		text = tailFileText(wrapperPath, maxBytes)
		textLines = text.splitlines()
		tailLines = "\n".join(textLines[-lines:])
		return {"text": "=== " + wrapperPath + " ===\n" + tailLines}
	except Exception as e:
		return {"text": "Error reading wrapper log: " + str(e)}

	gatewayAddress = self.session.props.gateway.address	
	
	# Try to extract the resolved wrapper path from:

	if firstLine.startswith("=== ") and firstLine.endswith(" ==="):
		resolvedPath = firstLine.replace("=== ", "").replace(" ===", "")

	header.append("Kanoa Wrapper Log Export")
	header.append("Exported: {}".format(ts))
	header.append("Gateway Host: {}".format(timezone))
	header.append("Gateway Address: {}".format(gatewayAddress))
	header.append("Project: {}".format(projectName))

	if resolvedPath: header.append("Resolved Path: {}".format(resolvedPath))
